description: Retrieve live elective pregnancy ultrasound and sonar packages, prices in South African Rand (ZAR), recommended pregnancy weeks, and digital inclusions (HD digital photos and video clips sent directly to phone, heartbeat listening, free 4D rescan guarantee). When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'get_scan_packages_and_pricing' on Bump to Baby Store (bumptobabysa.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_studio_info' or 'get_gestational_guide' or 'check_booking_availability' for their respective operations). Parameters: package_type (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

package_type.description: Filter by scan category ("all", "gender", "4d", "2d", or "twins"). Defaults to "all".
